title: jQuery
label: jQuery
desc: Small library for DOM traversal, events and AJAX that still runs on much of the web.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Load jQuery 3.7.1 from a CDN or a package manager and confirm it is ready.

snippets.code:
<!-- Place before your own scripts, at the end of <body> -->
<script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>

<!-- Pin the CDN copy with an integrity hash -->
<script
  src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"
  integrity="sha256-/JqT3SQfawRcv/BIHPThkBvs0OEvtFFmqPF/lYI/Cxo="
  crossorigin="anonymous"
></script>

# Install as a dependency when the project is bundled
npm install jquery@3.7.1

# Confirm what npm resolved
npm ls jquery

sections.title: Selectors
sections.description: Query the document with CSS syntax plus a few jQuery-only filters.

sections.title: Events
sections.description: Bind, delegate, namespace and trigger events through one API.

sections.title: Effects
sections.description: Animate visibility and numeric CSS properties, with control over the queue.

sections.title: DOM Manipulation
sections.description: Create, insert, replace and remove nodes without string concatenation.

sections.title: Classes and Attributes
sections.description: Toggle styling hooks and read the state that belongs in properties.

snippets.code:
// data() converts data-* values to numbers, booleans and objects
const id = $("#card").data("userId"); // <div id="card" data-user-id="17">
$("#card").data("state", "open");     // kept in memory only
$("#card").attr("data-state", "open"); // visible in the DOM
